title: skills objectstack-data seeds.md: name Seed.locale and Seed.fallback in the field table, and add an eval case for fallback (skills half of #34940 / PR #35065)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-I, mailbox #32588, 6966172163), on seat 3's ruling of 01:25Z (#35065 Q1 = B).

#34940 adds `Seed.fallback`: an optional `fallback: true` on a seed set that has `locale`. It loads when no locale-scoped set of the same object lists the resolved locale. PR #35065 carries the spec, loader, tests, liveness row and docs. The skills hunk was taken out so the code lands without a Tier H merge.

## This card carries
1. `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`: the field table names `locale` and `fallback`.
   - The os-dev's wording is in commit 7f6197ca36.
   - Fitting it under the `check-skills-token-ratchet` ceiling (1747 tokens) needed two restated best-practice rows deleted.
2. An eval case that exercises `fallback` in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`.

`skills/**` is governed (Tier H, L2).

Grade: **p2 · domain:skills**. Theme: MCP (skills that teach authoring) and install reliability (#34940). Routed to seat 4 under the p2 scope; seat 3 takes no new cards (directive of 01:24Z).
